24.original: Pick full-blown lilies south of Sextuplet Shallow.

25.original: Deliver the full-blown lilies to the caring Nu Mou.

48.original: Please, mortal, I require your aid. My precious porxie has been under the weather of late, and it needs some full-blown lilies to get better.

49.original: However, I cannot leave its side to do the picking. If you would go in my stead, I promise to give you a fitting payment.

50.original: Please, pick some full-blown lilies in my stead. I would go myself, but I cannot leave my precious porxie's side.

51.original: Ah, you're back. Do you have the lilies?

52.original: You have my gratitude! Now my precious porxie can recover!

53.original: Will I feed it the lilies, you ask? After a fashion. Being an arcane entity, it cannot simply eat them.

54.original: Instead, I will infuse it with the flowers' aether. To the creature, it would be as drinking sweet nectar─a sure way to lift the spirits! My thanks again, and please accept this as fitting payment for your kindness!
